messages.subject: INLA crashed - Assertion failed: (arg->Q->a[0] >= 0.0)...
parts:
Good morning, 

I run my model and get the following error (Verbose attached). My R is 4.3 so should be ok based on previous comments about similar errors. Not sure what is wrong because I am running ZIP models with other variables separately and it works fine, just this one seems problematic:

MODEL: 

pois_rankoutstroth <- inla(
  n ~ 1 + f(ID, model="bym", graph=UG.adj) + recode_rank_outstroth_fin,
  data = fmd_outbreaks,
  family = "zeroinflatedpoisson1",
  quantiles=c(0.025, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.975),
  E=Expected,
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
  verbose = TRUE
)

ERROR:

Assertion failed: (arg->Q->a[0] >= 0.0), function GMRFLib_tabulate_Qfunc_core, file tabulate-Qfunc.c, line 147.
